title: A generic stalk detects kernels in a locally constant sheaf
statement:
Let $S$ be a nonempty irreducible scheme with generic point $\eta$, and fix a
geometric point $\bar\eta$ over $\eta$. Let $F$ be a locally constant abelian
etale sheaf, let $G$ be any abelian etale sheaf, and let $\phi:F\to G$ be a
morphism. If $\phi_{\bar\eta}$ is injective, then $\phi$ is a monomorphism.

proof.text:
Let $N=\ker(\phi)\subseteq F$. By exactness of geometric stalks [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact], for every geometric point $ ar s$ the sequence $0	o N_{ ar s}	o F_{ ar s}	o G_{ ar s}$ is exact; in particular $N_{ ar\eta}=0$ and each $N_{ ar s}	o F_{ ar s}$ is injective. Suppose $N
eq0$. Then $N	o0$ is not an isomorphism, so by [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative] there is a geometric point $ ar s$ with $N_{ ar s}
eq0$. Since $F$ is locally constant as an abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], there are an etale $V	o S$ in the covering, an abelian group $M$ and an isomorphism $F|_V\cong\underline M$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] whose image contains the image of $ ar s$; since $V	imes_S\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ is a nonempty scheme etale over the algebraically closed field $\Omega$, it has an $\Omega$-point, i.e. $ ar s$ lifts to a geometric point $ ar v$ of $V$. (Elementary: every pointed etale neighbourhood $(U, ar u)$ of $ ar s$ is refined by $(U	imes_SV,( ar u, ar v))$, which lies over $V$; so by cofinality in the colimit of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] the stalk of $F|_V$ at $ ar v$ is $F_{ ar s}$, and likewise for $N$, and the same holds at every geometric point of $V$.) Choose a pointed etale neighbourhood $(U, ar u)$ of $ ar v$ in $V$ and $\sigma\in N(U)$ with nonzero germ; its image $	au\in F(U)$ has nonzero germ in $F_{ ar s}$. By [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-geometric-stalk] applied on $V$ at $ ar v$, transported along $F|_V\cong\underline M$, this germ is the germ of $\iota_V(m)$ for a unique $m\in M$, and $m
eq0$ because $\iota_V(0)=0$. Two elements of a filtered colimit that agree are already equal at some stage, so after replacing $(U, ar u)$ by a smaller pointed etale neighbourhood $(W, ar w)$ over $V$ we have $\sigma\in N(W)$ whose image in $F(W)$ corresponds to $\iota_V(m)|_W$, $m
eq0$. In particular $W$ is nonempty.

Etale morphisms are flat and locally of finite presentation, so by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-lfp-open] the image of $W\to S$ is a nonempty open of $S$; as $S$ is irreducible it contains $\eta$. Hence $W\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_{\bar\eta}$ is a nonempty scheme etale over an algebraically closed field and has a rational point, i.e. a geometric point $\bar w'$ of $W$ lying over $\bar\eta$. Then $(W,\bar w')$ is a pointed etale neighbourhood of $\bar\eta$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], so the germ of $\sigma$ there lies in $N_{\bar\eta}=0$, and therefore the germ of its image in $F_{\bar\eta}$ is $0$. On the other hand, by the cofinality remark of the previous step applied at the image $\bar v'$ of $\bar w'$ in $V$, $F_{\bar\eta}$ is the stalk of $F|_V\cong\underline M$ at $\bar v'$, and there the germ of $\iota_V(m)$ is the image of $m\neq0$ under the isomorphism $M\to\underline M_{\bar v'}$ of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-geometric-stalk], hence nonzero. This contradiction shows $N=0$, so $\phi$ is a monomorphism.

split_report.summary: Repaired the imported proof by citing exactness and conservativity of geometric stalks in the kernel argument, and by citing the stalk formula in the generic-point contradiction. No new nodes were needed because all non-elementary dependencies already exist in the DAG.
split_report.blueprint: The two proof steps realize the whole blueprint proof: form the kernel and use stalk conservativity, then use openness of the etale image and a geometric point over the generic point to obtain the contradiction.
